mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.25 percentage points over the next month, investors anticipate higher future inflation, which leads to a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > (current value + 0.25%) in the following month
regime_hint: Rising FOMC rates in late-cycle inflationary environment
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05) during the specified FEDFUNDS increase period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in PAYEMS (labor market activity) coinciding with a decline in UNRATE (unemployment) suggests a tight labor market, which precedes a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >10% in a month while UNRATE falls by >0.2 percentage points in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the defined labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in GDPC1 (real private demand) of at least 3% over the next quarter is associated with stronger economic momentum and a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 monthly increases for 3 consecutive months above previous month's value by ≥3%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05) during the demand growth episode.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in INDPRO (industrial production) and HOUST (housing starts) by at least 5% in the same month predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as weak supply signals market pessimism.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < (previous month) by ≥5% and HOUST < (previous month) by ≥5% in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is not statistically negative (p > 0.05) during the defined contraction.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 2% for three consecutive months, it signals accommodative policy, which is associated with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return in non-recession regimes.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the low-rate period.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4% followed by a rise in PAYEMS above 130,000 in the next month predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market improves.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS > 130000 in the following month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the defined labor signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RSAFS (retail sales) of over 8% in a month while CPIAUCSL (inflation) remains flat suggests soft demand, leading to a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < (previous month) by >8% and CPIAUCSL change < 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05) during the soft-demand episode.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPIAUCSL (inflation) by more than 0.4% in a month while FEDFUNDS stays below 3% predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates tighter policy.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by >0.4% in a month and FEDFUNDS < 3% in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the inflation spike.
